# Raven – The First Descendant (Nexon) – full data

Page: https://raven.freyna.org/
Official library: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/descendants/101000035
Data status: 01.10.2026 (NEXON library + Nexon Open API metadata)

All values on this page are max level: Descendant stats at Lv 40 (max), modules at their max enhancement level (Transcendent modules Lv 10). Weapons on the TFD pages are always listed at Lv 100 with 4 stars (Unique Ability Level 4).

## Overview
A Non-Attribute Melee DPS who uses the shadows to wreak havoc on enemy lines. She unleashes a fierce assault on enemies with a shotgun made of shadows.

## Facts
- Name: Raven (DE: Raven)
- Former name: Eleanore (given by her godfather Corvus, official story)
- Title: Queen of Darkness
- Role: Non-Attribute Melee DPS with a shotgun made of shadows
- Attribute: Non-Attribute
- Arche type of all skills: Fusion
- Custom Resource: Umbra (Max MP 0)
- Affiliation: former weapon of the Nightfall cartel; founder and ruler of the Guild
- Voice actor (EN): Janine Harouni
- Descendant ID: 101000035
- Ultimate version: none (as of 01.10.2026)
- Acquisition: Obtainable through Research

## Stats (Lv 40, max level)
- Max HP: 1,516
- Max Shield: 1,006
- Max MP: 0
- DEF: 1,858
- Shield Recovery Out of Combat: 4.88
- Shield Recovery In Combat: 4.08

## Skills
Cooldowns, costs and numeric skill values: not published in the official data.

### Queen of Darkness (DE: Königin der Dunkelheit)
- Slot: Passive | Type: Passive Skill | Element: Non-Attribute | Arche: Fusion
- Defeating an enemy, grants the Custom Resource Umbra.
- Equipping a shotgun activates Queen of Darkness. While active, firearm attacks deal additional damage per shot that hits and grant Domination. When Veil of Night is active, increases the amount of Additional Damage. Hitting an enemy inflicted with Trace or Bleed with a firearm, reloads a certain number of Rounds for the currently equipped weapon.
- When Domination is at max stacks, using an active skill instantly Reloads the firearm and removes the effect.
- When using Roll, Raven moves farther and retrieves Blade Feathers.

### Shadow Shot (DE: Schattenschuss)
- Slot: Skill 1 | Type: Active Skill | Element: Non-Attribute | Arche: Fusion
- Can be used after firing a shotgun a certain number of times to charge. The closer to the target, the greater the damage dealt.
- Inflicts Trace on hit enemies. Each Shotgun attack on an enemy with Trace deals additional damage to all enemies inflicted with Trace within range.
- Acquires Umbra proportional to the number of enemies hit by the Skill.

### Raven Feather (DE: Rabenfeder)
- Slot: Skill 2 | Type: Active Skill | Element: Non-Attribute | Arche: Fusion
- Sends a raven made of shadow flying forward. If the raven hits an enemy or terrain feature, it creates a Blade Feather at the location. If the raven does not create a Blade Feather, refunds a portion of the cooldown.
- Blade Feather inflicts Bleed on enemies within range. When reusing the skill, retrieves the Blade Feather and moves to that location. Grants Ambush.
- The raven and Blade Feather vanish when too far from Raven.

### Shadow Step (DE: Schattenschritt)
- Slot: Skill 3 | Type: Active Skill | Element: Non-Attribute | Arche: Fusion
- Quickly dashes forward. When the dash ends, inflicts Trace on enemies within range and grants Veil of Night.
- Veil of Night is removed after negating damage a certain number of times.
- Each Shotgun attack on an enemy with Trace deals additional damage to all enemies inflicted with Trace within range.

### Vendetta (DE: Vendetta)
- Slot: Skill 4 | Type: Active Skill | Element: Non-Attribute | Arche: Fusion
- Fires a shotgun repeatedly at nearby enemies. Additional input consumes Umbra to perform up to 5 attacks. The final attack deals heavy damage.
- The closer to the target, the greater the damage dealt.
- Reduces Incoming Damage while attacking, but being hit consumes additional Umbra Gauge. While using the skill, becomes immune to Knockdown and Knockback.

## Effects named in the skill texts
- Umbra: Custom Resource. Granted when defeating an enemy (Queen of Darkness); also acquired by Shadow Shot in proportion to enemies hit; consumed by Vendetta.
- Trace: Inflicted by Shadow Shot and Shadow Step. Each Shotgun attack on an enemy with Trace deals additional damage to all enemies with Trace within range.
- Blade Feather: Created by Raven Feather where the raven hits an enemy or terrain; inflicts Bleed on enemies within range; retrieved by reusing the skill or by Roll.
- Bleed: Inflicted by Blade Feather. Firearm hits on enemies with Trace or Bleed reload Rounds (Queen of Darkness).
- Ambush: Granted when Raven Feather is reused and Raven moves to the Blade Feather.
- Veil of Night: Granted by Shadow Step; removed after negating damage a certain number of times; increases Queen of Darkness Additional Damage.
- Domination: Granted by firearm hits while Queen of Darkness is active; at max stacks, using an active skill instantly reloads the firearm and removes the effect.

### Nightfall (DE: Anbruch der Nacht)
- Tier: Transcendent | Socket: Rutile | Slot: Skill | Max level: Lv 10 | Capacity at max level: 7 (Lv 0: 17)
- Effect (max level): Changes Raven Feather to an Attack Skill. / Increases AoE damage capability.
### Law of the Back Alley (DE: Gesetz des Hinterhofs)
- Tier: Transcendent | Socket: Cerulean | Slot: Skill | Max level: Lv 10 | Capacity at max level: 5 (Lv 0: 15)
- Effect (max level): Changed to a form not restricted to a specific Firearm. / Inflicts debuffs on the target, and deals Additional Damage proportional to the number of debuffs.
### Shadow's Resolve (DE: Schattenhafte Entschlossenheit)
- Tier: Ancestors | Socket: — | Slot: Main | Max level: no levels | Capacity at max level: 16
- Effect (max level): no fixed effect text in the official data (Ancestors module)

## Story
Quote: "Confirmed death of primary surveillance target 'Corvus.' 'Nightfall' has been completely taken over by an unidentified force overnight. Note: Evidence of intervention by an unregistered Arche ability user, aka the 'Ghost,' who has long been a surveillance target. Extreme caution is required." – An excerpt from a classified report by the Colon Special Forces, Albion Headquarters
Raven grew up as Eleanore, an orphan from Albion's back alleys. When she awakened an Arche ability that let her perfectly assimilate into the shadows, her godfather Corvus – the man who had given her the name Eleanore – made her the sharpest weapon of Nightfall, the most powerful faction in the back alleys.
Corvus' greed for power grew until he sold forbidden artifacts and even helpless orphans to the Vulgus as experimental subjects – a line Eleanore would never cross. She executed Corvus herself, then crushed and unified the fragmented cartels into a new, massive alliance called the Guild. Eleanore the "hunting hound" vanished, and Raven, the Queen of Darkness, came to rule.
Albion's back alleys were divided over her: a filthy traitor who repaid kindness with betrayal, or the Bloody Queen who brought strict order to a lawless land. Still, she asked herself how a life spent hiding in the shadows would differ from staying trapped in the refuge Corvus had created – so she stepped out of the shadows and, without hesitation, stood before the Albion Command that had pursued her for years.

## Exclusive Equipment / Ability: Exclusive Arche, Photonic Energy Control
Raven's Arche appears to rule the darkness, but the Magisters determined that her true ability is closer to manipulating photons – strictly limited to photon annihilation.
By annihilating photons she creates spaces devoid of light, and she is believed to convert the energy released during the annihilation into actual physical force. Several aspects defy the Magisters' current understanding of physics; they hoped to research it further, but Raven has refused.
Quote: "Remember this, Eleanore. The perfect hound never barks until it has its prey in its jaws." / "That's why you had no idea until the muzzle of this gun was pressed against your neck, Father." – Final conversation between Corvus and Raven
